description.en: Opens a generic positioned message window and waits for it to finish, if CMND_MESSAGE_OPEN successfully starts it.
Whether/how to center the message window horizontally.
Whether/how to center the message window vertically.
Whether to show the message window frame.
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

example.code:
// Show a generic message window
CreateMessage("ev100", false, false, true);
